Rich cut-paper / painted gouache treatment: expertly designed flowing silhouettes, subtle tactile grain, restrained soft dimensional shading, lovely rounded edges and carefully balanced details. A few overlapping soft sage and pale-lime organic shapes behind the figure create a cohesive contained composition and preserve contrast on both cream and dark forest UI backgrounds. Elegant independent wellness brand quality, inviting and memorable, polished enough for a featured App Store editorial illustration. Portrait 4:5 composition with generous transparent margin, centered subject, visually clear at 160-220 pixels wide. Genuine transparent background beyond the contained illustration. No typography, letters, logo, UI, borders, watermark, bar posts, scenery, extra people or limbs. Avoid stick figures, bean-shaped bodies, emoji, crude flat clip-art, thick black outlines, childish proportions, bodybuilding caricature, photorealism.
